narrative.overview:
Near-black ink on warm paper, at a console's density. Camarón's two surfaces, the portal where people read and the desktop app where they operate, share one theme (`.camarones/ui/theme/tokens.css`) and one component kit (`.camarones/ui`). Hierarchy comes from space, 1px rules and type weight, not from colour or shadow. The accent is not a hue: it is the highest-contrast ink the canvas allows, so a primary action reads as a solid black block in light mode and a solid paper block in dark mode.

Colour speaks only about state. Green, amber and red appear next to the word they qualify (confirmed, stale, failed), and the one chromatic voice outside state is Signal Violet: links, the focus ring and informational labels. The aurora colours are weather, not ink: soft radial washes behind the Home hero and an amber glow while something is running. Motion happens only when something changes, with transform and opacity alone.

Big Shoulders, a condensed impact face, carries the wordmark and page titles; Inter carries everything people read and operate. The look started from Cofundo's visual language, adapted for Camarón in `.claude/skills/cofundo-design-system/CAMARON.md`; this file records what ships today.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on warm paper, light theme canonical, dark theme derived with the same token names.
Console density: `-sm` and meta sizes in views; display sizes only on the Home hero.
Flat at rest; shadows only for what floats.
State colour always beside its word; text at 4.5:1 in both themes.
No icon system: text glyphs, with a short list of approved inline-SVG exceptions.

rules.name: The Ink-Not-Hue Rule
rules.body: The accent is the highest-contrast ink, not a colour. Primary actions are solid ink; a hue never marks importance.

rules.name: The State-Wears-Its-Word Rule
rules.body: A state colour never stands alone. The dot, the 3px rail or the coloured chip text always sits beside the word that names the state.

rules.name: The Aurora-Is-Weather Rule
rules.body: Aurora colours are backgrounds and glows only, never text. On the aurora wash, muted text steps up from Ink Dim to Ink Soft to keep 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Console Density Rule
rules.body: Views use body-small, meta (0.8125rem) and micro (0.6875rem). Display sizes belong to the Home hero and to the desktop ADR review's presentation mode (`P` to enter), nowhere else.

rules.name: The Figures-in-Mono Rule
rules.body: Counts, versions, costs and paths are set in mono, so numbers line up and read as data.

rules.name: The Space-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never cast a shadow. If two areas need separating, use space or a 1px rule first.

dos: Do take every value from `.camarones/ui/theme/tokens.css` (`--color-*`, `--text-*`, `--consola-radio-*`, `--sombra-*`, `--ease-*`, `--duration-*`); views never hold a raw colour.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 in both themes, and step muted text up to Ink Soft on the aurora wash.
Do put the state's word beside every state colour: dot, rail, chip or tile.
Do use the one focus ring: 2px solid Signal Violet, 2px offset.
Do keep corners at 3px (small parts), 4px (controls) and 6px (cards, dialogs).
Do give every control at least a 24px target; default buttons and fields are 40px.
Do move only `transform` and `opacity`, with `--ease-out-soft` and 200 / 400 / 800ms, and stand still under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do serve fonts from `.camarones/ui/theme/fonts/` and nothing from a CDN.
donts: Don't draw 99px pills or radii above 6px; the legacy `.pill`, `.count` and `.chip` rules are drift.
Don't set text in an aurora colour or in Shrimp Coral.
Don't use display sizes outside the Home hero and the ADR presentation mode.
Don't give resting cards a shadow.
Don't add an icon set or let emoji stand in for words; inline SVG only in the exceptions listed in `CAMARON.md`.
Don't draw the shrimp a second time: the favicon (`portal/app/public/favicon.svg`) is the one drawing of the mark.
Don't tell a state by colour alone.
